data.gender_notes: Abrarah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Abrarah is derived from the Arabic word 'abir' which means most merciful. This name signifies a servant or devotee of Allah, the Most Merciful. In the Quran, the term 'abir' is used to describe Allah's mercy and compassion towards His creation. The name Abrarah carries the meaning “Servant of the Most Merciful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Abrarah usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of the most merciful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
